props.text: Composition pattern (#37): a Branching Diagram wrapped in a Pan & Zoom View. The diagram has no pan/zoom of its own — the wrapper supplies it. BranchingCanvas (2100×840) holds nothing but the diagram, sized so the whole tree fits without the component growing its own scrollbars; Pan & Zoom measures that view (contentWidth/Height = 0) and makes it navigable: drag to pan, wheel to zoom, +/−/home/fit, minimap. Clicking a node still selects it through the wrapper.
